_comment: A thenable service reaches Inspectable.toJson's unknown parameter, which returns it; an async function returns the result, so the host adopts it. then hands its resolve function a nested thenable whose then calls another method of the service. Under the hand-written-thenable rule (adopting a non-native-Promise object with a callable then bails every service it can reach) the key bails, so every method stays, including the one nothing reads, and the bundle runs.
